subtitle: Computer Programming Basic
teachers:
TAKEMATA Kazuya
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
This course is designed to achieve the learning and education goal of the communication fundamentals in the Department of Environmental Design and Innovation.
In order to acquire the basic abilities of computer programming, students will be given a bird's-eye view of programming and an understanding of many of the basic terms and concepts of programming, such as branching, loops, functions, and objects.
advice: The purpose of this class is to learn the basics of program input, execution, and debugging through lectures, quizzes, and exercises　for programming. The programming language uses JavaScript, which is the most widely used for all purposes from embedded fields to servers. In the exercise, students will understand various control methods by JavaScript by executing them on a web browser and visually obtaining the results. The web browser used in the class is Google Chrome, so be sure to install Google Chrome on your laptop and bring that laptop with you every time. In addition, students must submit weekly assignments to review each lesson.
requiredKnowledge: Students need to understand basic PC operation methods such as creating, deleting, moving, and copying files and folders, and editing and saving text files. Students need to bring their PC every time.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain variables, data types, and arrangement.
Be able to understand how to use branching, loops, and functions.
Be able to make the control programs that perform in a web browser using JavaScript.
Be able to collect variables and functions into objects and use them.

              This course is designed to achieve the learning and education goal of the communication fundamentals in the Department of Environmental Design and Innovation.
In order to acquire the basic abilities of computer programming, students will be given a bird's-eye view of programming and an understanding of many of the basic terms and concepts of programming, such as branching, loops, functions, and objects.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The purpose of this class is to learn the basics of program input, execution, and debugging through lectures, quizzes, and exercises　for programming. The programming language uses JavaScript, which is the most widely used for all purposes from embedded fields to servers. In the exercise, students will understand various control methods by JavaScript by executing them on a web browser and visually obtaining the results. The web browser used in the class is Google Chrome, so be sure to install Google Chrome on your laptop and bring that laptop with you every time. In addition, students must submit weekly assignments to review each lesson.
